summary: Implemented Phase 1 of a plan to support live reloading of linked extensions in the agent-server: added tsx watch exclusions for Pi agent dir and registry clones, swapped the linked-extension loader from native import to a fresh jiti instance per rescan, added dispose hooks to extensions and a rebuildable project-service registry, and created an extension catalog module. Added a `jiti` dependency to agent-server and verified the loader's existing tests still pass under the new loader.
decisions: Use jiti instead of native `import()` for loading linked extensions so each rescan gets a fresh module graph (tsx/jiti compilation is CPU-bound; sequential imports are required).

Add tsx watch exclusions covering the Pi agent directory (which contains junctions into registry clones) and the registry clones themselves; paths are forward-slashed for tsx's glob matcher on every platform.
Each extension exposes an optional `dispose()` hook called when the extension is replaced or unregistered; a dispose failure must not block the reload.
Project services are tracked in a rebuildable registry keyed by extension id, with diffing to determine which services were replaced vs removed across rescans.
Protocol version remains 28 in this segment; the loader refactor was validated via the existing `load-extensions.test.ts` (2 tests pass).
errors: A bash heredoc appended to dev-process.ts munged backslash escapes in the watch-exclusion helper; fixed by rewriting the block with the Edit tool.
